Which of the following gives the area of the shaded region that lies between the polar curves r=sin⁡(2θ) and r=cos⁡(θ), as shown above?

Hint: In the first quadrant, the curves intersect when θ=π6 and θ=π2.

a
12∫0π/3(sin⁡(2θ)−cos⁡(θ))2dθ
b
12∫π/3π/2(sin2⁡(2θ)−cos2⁡(θ))2dθ
c
12∫π/6π/2(sin2⁡(2θ)−cos2⁡(θ))dθ
d
12∫0π/6(sin2⁡(2θ)−cos2⁡(θ))dθ
e
12∫0π/2(sin⁡(2θ)−cos⁡(θ))dθ
